snippet.title: The Wizard's Assistants Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Wizard’s Assistants is a single-player exploration adventure where you traverse a chaotic collapsing tower, help the assistants stranded within it, and gather quarks to gain magical augments as you search for a way upward to the moon.

About This Game:
Something has gone awry in the Wizard’s tower. As one of the assistants, explore a strange and increasingly chaotic world of magical experiments, scattered clues, and fellow assistants in need of help. Follow your curiosity, collect quarks, and earn new magical augments as you unravel what happened and find out how to escape.

The Gameplay:
Explore places within the tower ranging from the tower’s pipes to the Wizard's workshop, reaching as high up as the rafters. Run, climb, jump, and glide, all at your own pace. Talk with the assistants you encounter, and investigate the oddities the Wizard has left behind. Collect quarks to charge Nexus points to unlock magical augments that you can use to bounce, traverse ledges, teleport, ride beams of light, and puzzle your way through the tower, revealing paths that were previously out of reach. Along the way, examine notes, scrolls, and glyphs that gradually unveil the workings of the Wizard and the assistants who need your help to escape along with you.

Every place you visit invites another question, every assistant has another situation to resolve, and every augment leads to new experiments. Keep exploring, keep helping, and keep following the quarks upward to find out for yourself if the moon really is made of cheese.

90 Days of Joy:
The Wizard's Assistants was made possible by 90 Days of Joy, a 90-day game development challenge about making what you want to make. Follow along as we share experiments, ideas, discoveries, mistakes, and what reminds us of why we love making games.
